fact: Car 63 left the track and repoined gaining a lasting advantage, in Turn 12
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence, plus submissions from the teams of Cars 63 and 81 via the FIA Evidence Channel. The driver of Car 63 was defending position from Car 81, into Turn 12 and left the track, then proceeded to rejoin in front of Car 81, prior to Turn 13. He retained that position. Accordingly he is determined by the Stewards to have left the track, rejoined it and gained a lasting advantage. The normal penalty for this is a 10 second penalty, however the Stewards considered that the driver of Car 63 had previously been pressuring Car 6 and that put Car 81 into an attacking position (and therefore Car 63 into a defending position). Further, this was a first lap incident and in our determination, the penalty should be mitigated to 5 seconds.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 63 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
